import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.stream.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final int T = 14;
    static long up;

    static long qp(long a, long b) {
        long x = 1;
        a %= MOD;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) x = x * a % MOD;
            a = a * a % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return x;
    }

    static class LinearSeq {
        static int m;
        static long[] a = new long[233333];
        static long[] h = new long[233333];
        static long[] t_ = new long[233333];
        static long[] s = new long[233333];
        static long[] t = new long[233333];

        static List<Integer> BM(List<Integer> x) {
            List<Integer> ls = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> cur = new ArrayList<>();
            int lf = 0;
            int ld = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < x.size(); ++i) {
                long t = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.size(); ++j) {
                    t = (t + (long)x.get(i - j - 1) * (long)cur.get(j)) % MOD;
                }
                if ((t - x.get(i)) % MOD == 0) continue;
                if (cur.isEmpty()) {
                    cur = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(i + 1, 0));
                    lf = i;
                    ld = (int)((t - x.get(i)) % MOD);
                    continue;
                }
                long k = (-(x.get(i) - t) % MOD + MOD) % MOD * qp(ld, MOD - 2) % MOD;
                List<Integer> c = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(i - lf - 1, 0));
                c.add((int)k);
                for (int j = 0; j < ls.size(); ++j) {
                    c.add((int)((-ls.get(j) * k) % MOD));
                }
                if (c.size() < cur.size()) {
                    while (c.size() < cur.size()) c.add(0);
                }
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.size(); ++j) {
                    c.set(j, (int)(((long)c.get(j) + (long)cur.get(j)) % MOD));
                }
                if (i - lf + (int)ls.size() >= cur.size()) {
                    ls = new ArrayList<>(cur);
                    lf = i;
                    ld = (int)((t - x.get(i)) % MOD);
                }
                cur = c;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < cur.size(); ++i) {
                cur.set(i, (int)(((long)cur.get(i) % MOD + MOD) % MOD));
            }
            return cur;
        }

        static void mull(long[] p, long[] q) {
            Arrays.fill(t_, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                if (p[i] != 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                        t_[i + j] = (t_[i + j] + p[i] * q[j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = m + m - 1; i >= m; --i) {
                if (t_[i] != 0) {
                    for (int j = m - 1; j >= 0; --j) {
                        t_[i - j - 1] = (t_[i - j - 1] + t_[i] * h[j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) p[i] = t_[i];
        }

        static long calc(long K) {
            Arrays.fill(s, 0);
            Arrays.fill(t, 0);
            s[0] = 1;
            if (m != 1) t[1] = 1;
            else t[0] = h[0];
            while (K > 0) {
                if ((K & 1) == 1) mull(s, t);
                mull(t, t);
                K >>= 1;
            }
            long su = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                su = (su + s[i] * a[i]) % MOD;
            }
            return (su % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }

        static int work(List<Integer> x, long n) {
            if (n < x.size()) return x.get((int)n);
            List<Integer> v = BM(x);
            m = v.size();
            if (m == 0) return 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                h[i] = v.get(i);
                a[i] = x.get(i);
            }
            return (int)calc(n);
        }
    }

    static long check(long n) {
        long ans = 0;
        String st = Long.toString(n);
        int len = st.length();
        if (n > 0) ans++;
        for (int i = 1; i < T; i++) {
            long cur = 1;
            long num = n;
            for (int j = 0; j + 1 < i; j++) {
                cur = cur * 10;
            }
            for (int j = len; j < i; j++) num *= 10;
            if (i < len) {
                String pref = "";
                for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) pref += st.charAt(j);
                num = Long.parseLong(pref);
                num++;
            }
            if (num > up) num = up;
            if (num > cur) ans += num - cur;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        n++;

        long part = (n % MOD) * ((n / MOD1) + 2) % MOD;

        ans %= MOD;

        System.out.println(ans);
